hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Calculate the total count of apples across all packs.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: To minimize the number of boxes used, greedily pick boxes with the largest capacities.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Sort capacity descending. Accumulate box capacity until it meets or exceeds total apples.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all subsets of boxes takes exponential time O(2^m).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort capacities in descending order to apply the greedy choice property.
